coverage: Two reported business groups · group totals
definition: What each business group earned before company-wide costs, interest, unusual charges and tax. It is different from the profit HPL reported after all these costs.
location: Audited consolidated statement, rows 1 and 5–10, and Consolidated Segmentwise Revenue, Results, Assets and Liabilities, sections (a) and (b), audited year ended 31 March 2026 column.
notes: The company reported no sales between its two business groups in this table. Subtract company-wide costs after other income, interest and an unusual charge to reach group profit before tax of ₹123.48 crore. Group profit after tax was ₹91.25 crore, of which ₹91.01 crore was attributable to HPL’s shareholders.
insight: Metering, Systems & Services brought in more sales and earned more before shared costs than Consumer, Industrial & Services this year. The metering group covers more than smart electricity meters, so use the row to understand the business group as a whole.
